info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Discount Overview API
info.description: The Product Discount Overview API allows users to retrieve detailed information about discount pricing associated with specific banking products. By providing a product identifier, consumers can access the discount rates, eligibility criteria, and related terms. This API is particularly useful for financial analysts, customer service representatives, and developers integrating discount functions into banking applications. By leveraging this endpoint, businesses can enhance customer support and improve pricing strategy analysis.

get.summary: Retrieve discount pricing details for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the discount pricing information associated with the specified resource ID. Use this endpoint to understand any applicable discounts and pricing structures.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving discount pricing information for a specific product.

GetDiscountPricingForResourceRequest.description: This schema represents the body of the request for the discount pricing operation. It is expected to be a string type.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes a Bearer authentication method, where the client must include a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the authorization header for secure access to the API. The JWT format is used to ensure the integrity and authenticity of the claims being transferred.
